title: Self-Healing Harness for Runtime Oversight of Agent Self-Modification
abstract: arXiv:2609.24130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents can change their own future behavior, raising a basic control question of which self-generated changes should be allowed to persist. We formulate this as admission control for self-modification. The agent may propose changes to its operating instructions, while an external runtime gate controls persistence. We implement this principle as a model-agnostic self-healing harness that runs a Detect, Notice, Heal, Validate loop around an otherwise unmodified agent. The agent authors candidate behavioral rules in an external workspace, where they receive provisional execution authority during evaluation and acquire persistent cross-episode authority only after measured improvement on the triggering failure without regression beyond a fixed margin on protected cases. Replay provides matched evidence when available, forward trials provide a weaker fallback, and a corpus-level guard re-tests the accumulated active rule set. Across 16 ma

translated_title: 用于智能体自我修改运行时监督的自愈框架
translated_abstract: LLM智能体可以改变自己未来的行为，这引出了一个基本的控制问题：哪些自我生成的更改应该被允许持久保留。我们将此问题形式化为自我修改的准入控制。智能体可以提出对其操作指令的更改，而外部运行时门控则控制这些更改的持久化。我们将这一原则实现为一个模型无关的自愈框架，它在一个未经修改的智能体周围运行“检测、注意、修复、验证”循环。智能体在外部工作区中编写候选行为规则，这些规则在评估期间获得临时执行权限，只有在触发故障上测得改进且在受保护案例上没有超出固定阈值的回归后，才能获得持久的跨回合权限。重放机制在可用时提供匹配的证据，前向试验提供较弱的回退方案，而语料库级防护则重新测试累积的活动规则集。在16个（摘要截断）...
tldr: 提出了一种模型无关的自愈框架，通过外部运行时门控对LLM智能体的自我修改实施准入控制，只有经过验证能改进触发故障且在受保护案例上无回归的行为规则才能获得持久权限。
en_tdlr: A model-agnostic self-healing harness implements admission control for LLM agent self-modification, where an external runtime gate only grants persistent authority to behavioral rules verified to improve triggering failures without regression on protected cases.
